notes.title: MCP
notes.summary: A standard protocol by Anthropic built on top of tool calling that exposes JSON-RPC endpoints for LLMs to communicate with external services as plugins.

notes.title: LangGraph
notes.summary: A graph-based framework for orchestrating stateful, multi-agent workflows with loops, branching, and state persistence.

notes.title: Router Pattern
notes.summary: An architectural pattern where an LLM or classifier acts as a dispatcher to direct incoming queries to specialized tools, indexes, or prompt pathways.

notes.title: Speculative Decoding
notes.summary: An optimization technique using a smaller model to generate candidate tokens validated in a single pass by a larger model to increase token throughput.

notes.title: vLLM
notes.summary: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference engine for LLMs, featuring PagedAttention.

notes.title: Decoder
notes.summary: Decoder layers generate tokens autoregressively with causal (left-to-right) attention; the dominant architecture for modern generative LLMs.

notes.title: Encoder
notes.summary: Encoder layers in transformers extract features from the full input via bidirectional attention; used alone for NLU tasks or with a decoder in seq2seq models.

notes.title: LLMs
notes.summary: Central hub for all notes related to Large Language Models (LLMs), including architecture, retrieval, and optimization.

notes.title: Tool Calling
notes.summary: Tool calling enables LLMs to run code and perform tasks beyond text generation, introducing a 4-message architecture and requiring careful context and tool design for long-horizon agentic tasks.

notes.title: Modular Monolith
notes.summary: A deep dive into why Modular Monoliths are often the best choice for maximizing development velocity and managing volatility without the "distributed system tax."

notes.title: Splitting Microservices
notes.summary: A comprehensive guide on decomposing systems into microservices using DDD, volatility, data compliance, technology runtimes, and organizational structure.

notes.title: Domain-Driven Design
notes.summary: A foundational overview of Domain-Driven Design core concepts including Ubiquitous Language, Aggregates, and Bounded Contexts within a microservices architecture.

notes.title: Coupling
notes.summary: An overview of the four main coupling types in microservice systems — Domain, Temporal, Pass-Through, and Common — with strategies for minimising or replacing each.

notes.title: Agent Communication
notes.summary: An overview of different communication topologies and patterns for multi-agent systems, including linear, hierarchical, and network-based flows.

notes.title: Agents
notes.summary: An exploration of what defines an AI agent, focusing on the transition from simple chatbots to autonomous systems using reasoning, tools, and frameworks like ReAct.

notes.title: Re-ranking
notes.summary: A two-stage retrieval process where initial candidates from a broad search are filtered by a specialized ranking engine to improve precision.

notes.title: Agentic RAG
notes.summary: Evolution of RAG into dynamic, autonomous systems where an LLM uses reasoning to manage the retrieval process, tool selection, and self-correction.

notes.title: Knowledge Graphs
notes.summary: Combining vector search with graph databases to capture complex entity relationships missed by pure semantic search.

notes.title: LightRAG
notes.summary: A specialized implementation of GraphRAG designed for efficiency and streamlined retrieval.

notes.title: LMCache
notes.summary: A specialized system for sharing token caches (KV caches) across multiple requests or instances to optimize LLM performance.

notes.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
notes.summary: Microsoft's framework for building knowledge graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation systems.

notes.title: Needle Haystack
notes.summary: Exploration of the needle-in-a-haystack problem, highlighting context retrieval biases and architectural limitations in long-context LLMs.

notes.title: Quantization
notes.summary: Techniques for reducing the precision of model weights to decrease memory usage and speed up inference.

notes.title: RAG
notes.summary: Overview of RAG modalities and strategies for augmenting LLM queries with external, up-to-date, or private data.

notes.title: Token Caching
notes.summary: A mechanism for reusing previously computed token states to speed up LLM inference and reduce computational costs.

notes.title: Tokenization
notes.summary: A research note exploring different tokenization methods used in LLMs, including character-level, word-level, and sub-word techniques like BPE.

notes.title: TurboQuant
notes.summary: A specialized inference kernel optimized for fast, quantized LLM execution.

notes.title: Coupling Cohesion
notes.summary: Discusses the importance of loose coupling and high cohesion in microservice architectures, referencing Constantine's Law.

notes.title: Service Boundaries
notes.summary: Exploration of service boundaries and information hiding in microservice architecture based on Sam Newman's Building Microservices.
